text: Independent law/CI court implemented and green. Added reusable GeometryLaws, AxisLaws, SampleSpaceLaws, SamplingLaws, and expanded ImageLaws for map identity/composition, exact-view identity/composition, canonical idempotence, copy preservation, zero-copy rebind, and aligned zip pointwise agreement. Property tests run on JVM and Scala.js. Added immutable registry concurrency stress (256 convergent restores and 256 deterministic conflicts), deterministic malformed NIfTI header fuzzing, and random legal shape/dtype/endian logical-order signatures. The first randomized run shrank an oracle error to seed kZlDprQVZYHpapi6r2P_AMbtK8k5yU1FZRJlcP6c5uH= and 1x2x2 Int32, demonstrating actionable seed/minimal reproduction; corrected oracle now explicitly converts NIfTI first-axis-fastest file order to logical last-axis-fastest order. Added JDK 17/21 matrix, optimized Scala.js/Node NIfTI, focused concurrency, isolated allocation, uploaded reports, and sbt-version-policy 3.2.1 early-semver first-baseline court. versionPolicyCheck passes with Compatibility.None appropriate to unreleased 0.1.0. Full non-locus court passes 296 JVM/Scala.js executions. Closure remains gated only on locus-specific laws and the open locus bridge child.
